create_BaseDatasetFetcher: create a _BaseDatasetFetcher instance with a dataset, auto_collation flag, collate_fn, and drop_last flag
create_IterableDatasetFetcher: create an _IterableDatasetFetcher that iterates over a dataset and fetches batches using collate_fn
create_MapDatasetFetcher: create a _MapDatasetFetcher that retrieves items by index from a map-style dataset and applies collate_fn
test_IterableDatasetFetcher_fetch: test the _IterableDatasetFetcher.fetch method with auto_collation enabled and a batched index list
test_MapDatasetFetcher_fetch: test the _MapDatasetFetcher.fetch method with __getitems__ support and auto_collation enabled
